domains.name: AI and the future of marketing

skills.name: Marketing fundamentals and strategy
skills.scope: What marketing is, customer value, STP (segmentation, targeting, positioning), the 4P/7P marketing mix, market analysis (SWOT, PESTEL, five forces), the evolution of marketing (Kotler 1.0→6.0), strategy in disruptive contexts, sustainable marketing, trends.

skills.name: Consumer psychology and insight
skills.scope: How people think and decide: attention, perception, memory, emotion, motivation, attitudes, persuasion, heuristics and biases, the decision process, consumer research, how an insight is found and written.

skills.name: Brand strategy
skills.scope: What a brand is, positioning, brand equity, the brand platform (purpose, values, personality, archetypes), brand architecture, extensions, building and revitalizing brands, personal branding.

skills.name: Advertising and communication strategy
skills.scope: How advertising works, communication objectives, effect models (AIDA, hierarchies, Rossiter-Percy), IMC, campaign planning, basic media planning, strategic mechanisms, measuring effectiveness.

skills.name: The creative brief
skills.scope: The role of the brief, agency brief structures and models, the single-minded proposition, Get/To/By, how to write and how to receive a brief, debriefing, typical mistakes.

skills.name: Ideation and creative thinking
skills.scope: What a creative idea is, the big idea, idea-generation techniques, visual ideas (metaphor, juxtaposition, exaggeration and others), shareworthy ideas, problem solving, judging ideas.

skills.name: Copywriting and message
skills.scope: Headlines, body copy, slogan/tagline, tone and voice, reason-why, persuasive text structures, writing for different channels, lessons from classic ads.

skills.name: Art direction and visual identity
skills.scope: Visual language, composition, typography, color, logo design, visual identity systems, ad layout, design for social, principles of lasting design.

skills.name: Storytelling and content
skills.scope: Narrative structures, brand storytelling, social media storytelling, content strategy, formats, user-generated content, content that gets shared.

skills.name: Digital and performance marketing
skills.scope: Digital strategy, website/UX, SEO, SEM/PPC, display and programmatic, email, analytics and KPIs, conversion, the post-cookie era, first-party data, advertising on Meta/Facebook.

skills.name: Social media and influencer marketing
skills.scope: Social media strategy, platforms, communities, algorithms, influencer marketing (types, selection, collaboration, measurement), the creator economy.

skills.name: Experiential marketing
skills.scope: Customer experience, experiential marketing, activations, events, retail and physical/digital experiences, customer experience design.

skills.name: AI in marketing and advertising
skills.scope: Generative AI in creative work and strategy, prompting for marketing, predicting behavior, personalization, intelligent customer engagement, automation, ethics and risks, transforming brands with AI.

skills.name: Pitch and presentation
skills.scope: The structure of a pitch, storytelling in a presentation, public speaking, managing nerves, delivery, Q&A, presenting creative ideas to the client.

skills.name: Portfolio and personal branding
skills.scope: Building the creative portfolio, selecting and curating projects, case studies, the UX portfolio, the visual/infographic CV, presenting yourself at an interview.

skills.name: Client, sales and business
skills.scope: The agency-client relationship, B2B selling, negotiation, presenting value, account management, the business of an advertising agency.

skills.name: Advertising history and culture
skills.scope: How advertising evolved, great agencies and creatives, classic ads and their lessons, the cultural and social context of advertising.
